summary: XcodeKit extends the Xcode source editor with commands and text buffer access. It exists only inside Xcode, a macOS developer tool that BifrOSt does not run or host. BifrOSt has no equivalent source editor extension point.

features.apple: XCSourceEditorExtension, Creating a Source Editor Extension
features.note: Extension point lives in Xcode. BifrOSt apps are not hosted by an IDE.
Commands appear in Xcode's Editor menu. No BifrOSt text editor exposes a command extension point.
Buffer access targets Xcode's editor. Text editing APIs for BifrOSt apps are covered by other frameworks (AppKit text, attributed strings).
Reports the Xcode version. Nothing to report on BifrOSt.

gaps: No IDE host: a source editor extension point would need an Xcode-like developer tool on BifrOSt, which does not exist. Not a gap to fill for a desktop.
